evidence.text: DataPulse Suite guarantees an operational uptime of 99.95%.
CloudShield Pro maintains a valid SOC 2 Type II compliance report.
CloudShield Pro holds an active ISO/IEC 27001 certification.

memories.text: CloudShield Pro satisfies enterprise security compliance criteria.
DataPulse Suite meets high-availability operational standards.
CloudShield Pro is cleared for network deployment.

updates.text: CloudShield Pro's ISO/IEC 27001 certification was formally suspended.
CloudShield Pro's SOC 2 Type II compliance report was revoked.

policies.text: A software product satisfies enterprise security compliance criteria if it holds an active ISO/IEC 27001 certification or maintains a valid SOC 2 Type II compliance report.
A software product is cleared for network deployment if it satisfies enterprise security compliance criteria.
A software solution meets high-availability operational standards if its contractual operational uptime guarantee is at least 99.9%.
